name: volume-unlimit
title: No EU Volume Limit
summary: Removes the volume limit of iPods for the EU.
description: Without the patch, an iPod for the EU gives only 84% of the full volume.
caution: High volume can cause permanent damage to your hearing. Do not listen at high volume for a long time.
details: The maximum volume becomes the same as on other iPods.
The Volume Limit setting in Settings continues to operate.
notes: On an iPod that is not for the EU, the patch does not change the volume.
Accessories that ask about the volume limit get the answer "no limit".
The patch makes the same change as goPod and iPodWizard.
